verses.text: Then Zophar from Naamah answered:
"Shouldn't all these words be answered? Is someone who talks so much proved right?
Should your bragging make people keep quiet? When you make fun of God, shouldn't someone make you ashamed?
You say to God, 'What I believe is pure, and I am clean in your sight.'
But oh, how I wish God would speak and open his mouth against you!
I wish he would show you the secrets of wisdom, because true wisdom has two sides. Know this: God is punishing you less than your sin deserves.
Can you understand the deep things of God? Can you discover the limits of the Almighty?
They are higher than the heavens. What can you do? They are deeper than the grave. What can you know?
They are longer than the earth and wider than the sea.
If God comes along and puts someone in prison and calls him to court, who can stop him?
He knows who is false. When he sees evil, doesn't he take note of it?
A foolish person will become wise when a wild donkey gives birth to a human.
But if you give your heart to God and lift your hands to him in prayer,
if you put away the sin that is in your hand and do not let evil live in your home,
then you will be able to lift your face without shame. You will stand firm and not be afraid.
You will forget your trouble. You will remember it only like water that has flowed away.
Your life will be brighter than noon. Even darkness will be like morning.
You will feel safe, because there is hope. You will look around and rest in safety.
You will lie down, and no one will frighten you. Many people will want your favor.
But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to escape. Their only hope will be death."
